coastline: Holds coastline features; grain = one row per named coastline feature (name) with geometry (coastline_geom) and partition/cluster info (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
csa: Holds combined statistical area (CSA) geographies; grain = one row per CSA (geo_id) with identifiers (csa_code, name, lsad_name, msa_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code), area measures (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point coordinates and geometry (internal_point_lon, internal_point_lat, internal_point_geom), CSA polygon (csa_geom) and partition/cluster (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
railways: Holds railway features; grain = one row per railway feature (geo_id) with name (full_name), feature code (mtfcc_feature_class_code), geometry (railway_geom), and partition/cluster (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
cbsa: Holds core-based statistical area (CBSA) geographies; grain = one row per CBSA (geo_id) with parent CSA link (csa_geo_id), codes (cbsa_fips_code), names (name, lsad_name, lsad_code), indicators (msa_indicator, mtfcc_feature_class_code), area measures (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point (internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom), CBSA polygon (cbsa_geom), and partition/cluster (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
adjacent_counties: Holds adjacency listings for counties; grain = one row per county (county, state, county_fips_code) listing neighbor county names (neighbors), neighbor states (neighbors_state), and neighbor FIPS codes (neighbors_fips_code).
counties: Holds county geographies; grain = one row per county (geo_id) with identifiers and codes (state_fips_code, county_fips_code, county_gnis_code, county_name, lsad_name, lsad_code, fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code), higher-level area codes (csa_fips_code, cbsa_fips_code, met_div_fips_code), status (functional_status), area measures (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point (int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom), county polygon (county_geom), and partition/cluster (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
adjacent_states: Holds adjacency listings for states; grain = one row per state (state, state_name, state_fips_code) listing neighbor states (neighbors_state) and neighbor FIPS codes (neighbors_fips_code).
metropolitan_divisions: Holds metropolitan division geographies; grain = one row per met division (geo_id) with codes and links (csa_code, cbsa_code, metdiv_code), names (name, lsad_name, lsad_code), feature code (mtfcc_feature_class_code), area measures (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point (internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom), metdiv polygon (metdiv_geom), and partition/cluster (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
states: Holds state geographies; grain = one row per state (geo_id) with regional codes (region_code, division_code), identifiers (state_fips_code, state_gnis_code, state, state_name, lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code), status (functional_status), area measures (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point (int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom), state polygon (state_geom), and partition/cluster (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
cnecta: Holds CT Nonmetropolitan and Economic Transit Areas (CNECTA) geographies; grain = one row per CNECTA (geo_id) with code (cnecta_fips_code), names (name, name_lsad, lsad), feature code (mtfcc_feature_class_code), area measures (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point (int_point_lat, int_point_lon), geometry (cnecta_geom), and partition/cluster (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
congress_district_<N>: Holds congressional district geographies for a state/dataset variant; grain = one row per district (geo_id) with state and district codes (state_fips_code, district_fips_code), LSAD info (lsad_name, lsad_code), congress_session, feature code (mtfcc_feature_class_code), status (functional_status), area measures (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point (int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom), district polygon (district_geom), and partition/cluster (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
zip_codes: Holds ZIP code geographies; grain = one row per ZIP code (zip_code) with place and jurisdiction info (city, county, state_fips_code, state_code, state_name), classification and feature code (fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code), status (functional_status), area measures (area_land_meters, area_water_meters), internal point (internal_point_lat, internal_point_lon, internal_point_geom), ZIP polygon (zip_code_geom), and partition/cluster (PARTITION, CLUSTER).
nws_forecast_regions: Holds weather forecast regions; grain = one row per forecast region (one region identified by state, cwa, fe_area, zone, etc.); keys/measures = state, cwa, time_zone, fe_area, zone, name, state_zone, lon, lat, shortname, shape_geometry.
urban_areas: Holds urban area boundaries and attributes; grain = one row per urban area (geo_id/urban_area_code); keys/measures = geo_id, urban_area_code, name, lsad_name, area_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, type, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lon, internal_point_lat, internal_point_geom, urban_area_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
national_outline: Holds national outline geometry rows; grain = one row per geographic outline record (affiliated geo unit); keys/measures = us_outline_geom, aff_geo_id, geo_id, name.
tlc_yellow_trips_<N>: Holds taxi trip records for a yellow taxi dataset partition; grain = one row per taxi trip (trip-level); keys/measures = vendor_id, pickup_datetime, dropoff_datetime, passenger_count, trip_distance, pickup_longitude, pickup_latitude, rate_code, store_and_fwd_flag, dropoff_longitude, dropoff_latitude, payment_type, fare_amount, extra, mta_tax, tip_amount, tolls_amount, imp_surcharge, total_amount.
tree_census_<N>: Holds urban tree census observations; grain = one row per inventoried tree (recordid); keys/measures = recordid, address, house_number, street, zip_original, cb_original, site, species, diameter, status, wires, sidewalk_condition, support_structure, borough, x, y, longitude, latitude, cb_new, zip_new, censustract_2010, censusblock_2010, nta_2010, segmentid, spc_common, spc_latin, location.
tlc_fhv_trips_<N>: Holds for-hire vehicle (FHV) trip or dispatch records; grain = one row per FHV pickup/dispatch event (location_id + pickup_datetime); keys/measures = location_id, pickup_datetime, dispatching_base_num, borough, zone, service_zone.
tlc_green_trips_<N>: Holds green taxi trip records; grain = one row per green taxi trip (trip-level); keys/measures = vendor_id, pickup_datetime, dropoff_datetime, store_and_fwd_flag, rate_code, pickup_longitude, pickup_latitude, dropoff_longitude, dropoff_latitude, passenger_count, trip_distance, fare_amount, extra, mta_tax, tip_amount, tolls_amount, ehail_fee, total_amount, payment_type, distance_between_service, time_between_service, trip_type, imp_surcharge.
citibike_stations: Holds Citibike station metadata and realtime availability; grain = one row per station (station_id); keys/measures = station_id, name, short_name, latitude, longitude, region_id, rental_methods, capacity, eightd_has_key_dispenser, num_bikes_available, num_bikes_disabled, num_docks_available, num_docks_disabled, is_installed, is_renting, is_returning, eightd_has_available_keys, last_reported.
tree_species: Holds species reference records for trees; grain = one row per species (species_scientific_name); keys/measures = species_scientific_name, species_common_name, form, growth_rate, fall_color, environmental_tolerances, location_tolerances, notes_suggested_cultivars, tree_size, comments.
citibike_trips: Holds Citibike trip logs; grain = one row per bike trip (tripduration with start/stop times and stations); keys/measures = tripduration, starttime, stoptime, start_station_id, start_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_id, end_station_name, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude, bikeid, usertype, birth_year, gender.
311_service_requests: Holds 311 non-emergency service request records; grain = one row per service request (unique_key); keys/measures = unique_key, created_date, closed_date, agency, agency_name, complaint_type, descriptor, location_type, incident_zip, incident_address, street_name, cross_street_1, cross_street_2, intersection_street_1, intersection_street_2, address_type, city, landmark, facility_type, status, due_date, resolution_description, resolution_action_updated_date, community_board, borough, x_coordinate, y_coordinate, park_facility_name, park_borough, bbl, open_data_channel_type, vehicle_type, taxi_company_borough, taxi_pickup_location, bridge_highway_name, bridge_highway_direction, road_ramp, bridge_highway_segment, latitude, longitude.
nypd_mv_collisions: Holds NYPD motor vehicle collision records; grain = one row per collision incident (unique_key/timestamp/location); keys/measures = borough, contributing_factor_vehicle_1, contributing_factor_vehicle_2, contributing_factor_vehicle_3, contributing_factor_vehicle_4, contributing_factor_vehicle_5, cross_street_name, timestamp, latitude, longitude, location, number_of_cyclist_injured, number_of_cyclist_killed, number_of_motorist_injured, number_of_motorist_killed, number_of_pedestrians_injured, number_of_pedestrians_killed, number_of_persons_injured, number_of_persons_killed, off_street_name, on_street_name, unique_key, vehicle_type_code1, vehicle_type_code2, vehicle_type_code_3, vehicle_type_code_4, vehicle_type_code_5, zip_code.
